definitions.gloss: to step forward; to step out
definitions.explanation: To physically move a foot forward or step outside a boundary.

definitions.gloss: to take the first step; to embark on
definitions.explanation: To begin a new endeavor or venture, often overcoming hesitation. A figurative extension of the physical meaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白線|はくせん}→白線：15902_hakusen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}さないで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do not step past the white line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ステージ→ステージ：11047_suteeji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦{力強|ちからづよ}く→力強い：03119_chikarazuyoi⟧⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}した。
examples.english: She took a strong step toward the stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To step into a new world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I gathered my courage and took the first step.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧だった⟦{独立|どくりつ}→独立：03488_dokuritsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧、ついに⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}すことにした。
examples.english: I finally decided to take the first step toward my long-held dream of going independent.

notes:
{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}す is a transitive godan verb. Compound of ⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧ (to step on) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out). Sense 2 is very common in motivational and life-change contexts.

ASPECT (ている):
Rarely used in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form since it describes a momentary action.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}す (take a step)
- ～⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}す (step out toward)
- ～⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}す (step out from)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}す (take the first step)
- ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}す (take the very first step)
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}す (take a new step forward)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{踏|ふ}み{込|こ}む→踏み込む：06972_fumikomu⟧: to step into, to tread into (entering a place or situation more deeply)
- ⟦{乗|の}り{出|だ}す→乗り出す：05760_noridasu⟧: to set out, to embark (emphasizes beginning an active venture)
